title: Cleaner outlines retained. Further tests barely change the picture.
summary: Viewer review found much cleaner outlines in the current experiment, with a few local traces of noise. Two follow-up tests barely changed the picture and were not adopted. Opening and ending sequences still need separate treatment.
problem: Shifting speckles near drawn outlines can remain after cleaning. Removing them must preserve the drawing.
response: The previous version, Temporal10, remains the experimental reference after positive viewer feedback. The new test, Temporal11, and its follow-up showed almost no visible extra benefit and were not adopted.
beforeDetail: Archived comparison, 31 October: the previous version in the episode 8 Orihime close-up.
afterDetail: Archived comparison, 31 October: the new test at the identical moment and crop. Differences remain subtle.
imageNote: 3 November: no newly cleared public pair. The featured image is the archived 31 October comparison, not today’s experiment.
stageNote: Step 3 of the four-step review cycle: check the result and retain the better-supported version.
nextStep: Investigate remaining local outline noise with a distinct hypothesis. Review opening and ending motion separately before approving any correction.
